_about: Hand-made truth for experiment 26, read from the page images (out/pages/*.png) on 2026-10-06. For each document: the pages read; the title, authors and rubric as printed; every section heading on those pages (page, text as printed); every note marker in the body text of those pages that has a note at the foot of its page (page, the note's printed label; 'marker' when the printed marker differs from the note's label); text that is page furniture (running heads, footers) and must not be article text. 'headings_optional' are lines a reader could call either way (not counted either way). Headings and links are scored only on the pages read. 'endnote_links': markers whose note is in the list at the end of the article (scored on 'endnote_pages').

0290-000-005-003.title: توجيه القراءات
0290-000-005-003.notes: p1 is a title page (calligraphic title, author 'د/ عبد العزيز احمد اسماعيل' and his post). p3: the marker (٣) has its note printed with the label (٤) (a misprint), so it is not counted; p4: note (٩) has no marker in the text. 'إحداهما' / 'ثانيتهما' on p2 are run-in labels, not headings.

0387-000-006-004.title: هاء الكناية والدرس الصوتي المطبق في القرآن الكريم
0387-000-006-004.notes: Title set as a banner over two lines ('هاء الكناية' large at the right); byline 'للدكتور التهامي الراجي' in a frame. The notes are endnotes (markers (1)..(19) on pp1-4, no note at the foot of these pages), so no footnote link is counted; the endnote links are scored on pp1 and 3, where the markers read clearly: (1)..(6) on p1, (8)..(16) on p3. The list items on p2 (1 - موصولة بمد ...) are a list, not headings.

0599-000-123-004.title: الإيمان بالله وأسمائه وصفاته وتقوية المراقبة الإلهية

headings.text: أسماء الله وكيف تقوى بها المراقبة:

0599-000-123-004.notes: Journal البيان, issue 123 (footer on every page: '• البيان • 30' and '• العدد • 123'). The rubric 'دراسات شرعية' is white on a grey tab at the right edge; the vertical tab on even pages repeats the title (a running head).

0631-006-002-013.title: الاستحسان والمصالح المرسلة
0631-006-002-013.notes: No byline anywhere in the article (the basmala under the title is not an author). No headings, no notes; page numbers 5195-5200 at the foot.

0652-000-001-004.title: الإسلام في مواجهته للماديين في قضية الألوهية
0652-000-001-004.notes: Byline 'بقلم الدكتور / محمد أبو الغيط الفرت / الأستاذ المساعد بكلية أصول الدين بالقاهرة' over three centred lines; page numbers at the top (- 80 - ...).

0656-014-010-014.title: من صور الاشقياء والسعداء
0656-014-010-014.notes: Two columns. Page 3 ends the article; the framed box 'إعلان' under it is an advertisement, not a section of the article. '* * *' separators are not headings.

0787-011-001-003.title: العربية المفترى عليها
furniture: مجلة كلية الدراسات الإسلامية والعربية للبنات
0787-011-001-003.notes: Page 1 is a decorated title page ('العربية' / 'المفترى عليها' on two lines, 'الأستاذ الدكتور محمد أبو المكارم قنديل'); pp2-3 repeat title and author at the top of the text (not headings). Running head: the journal's name.

0792-019-010-005.title: الدواعي الصحية لتنظيم النسل
0792-019-010-005.notes: p1 marker 2 is printed '٢)' (no opening bracket); p2's marker for note (٣) is printed (٢) — a misprint, kept in the truth: a reader would follow it to note 3.

1005-000-001-002.title: السلطة في الإسلام دراسة في نشوء الخلافة
1005-000-001-002.notes: p1 is a half-title (title and author), p2 blank, p3 repeats title and author over the text. Sections are numbered with Roman numerals alone on a line.

1090-001-004-011.title: رسالة المسجد في الإسلام
1090-001-004-011.notes: A sermon in three columns: rubric 'خطبة منبرية' in calligraphy at the top right, the title in large calligraphy, the byline 'الشيخ مصطفى كمال التارزي' in a frame; the name is repeated as a signature at the end (p4).
